title: Watch: L.B. Foster and Pittsburgh Football Donates to UPMC Children's Hospital Foundation
summary: On Monday, December 1, 2025, L.B. Foster and the University of Pittsburgh Football presented a check for $50,000 dollars to UPMC Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh in Pittsburgh, PA. Pitt Football's media team put together a video of the check presentation and visit to the hospital.
body_markdown:
We are deeply grateful for the opportunity to support UPMC Children's Hospital Foundation through our partnership with University of Pittsburgh athletics. This initiative reflects our shared commitment to making a positive difference in the community.


A special thank you to Pitt Football's media team, for capturing these memorable moments and creating this wonderful video. Your efforts help showcase the impact of coming together for a meaningful cause.


Read more:[L.B. Foster and The University of Pittsburgh Football Donates $50,000 to UPMC Children's Hospital](https://lbfoster.com/news/lb-foster-and-the-university-of-pittsburgh-football-donates-50000-to-upmc-childrens-hospital) .
